MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING (MOU) 
 
 This Memorandum of Understanding (“ MOU ”) is entered into at Lahore on this [●] day of [●] 2019 (“ Effective Date ”), by and between [●] (“ Zameen ”), [●] (“ Partner ”) and [●] (“ Landowner ”) ( hereinafter individually referred to as “ Party ” and collectively as “Parties ” ) . 
 
 WHEREAS : 
 Landowner is the sole , lawful, exclusive, and beneficial owner of property measuring [●] located at [●] (“ Property ”) ; 
 Zameen and Partner intend to enter into a joint venture (“ Joint Venture ”) with respect to a real estate Project (defined below) and are executing this MOU to document such intention; and 
 The Parties acknowledge that a business transaction of this nature involves terms and conditions that shall be agreed upon at a subsequent stage and, as such, this MOU shall be non-binding and subject to final definitive agreements that the Parties may execute in the future. 
 
 NOW THEREFORE , the Parties agree as follows: 
 
 DEFINITIONS 
 
 Cash Disbursal Model means a mutually agreed disbursal model of cash flow s of the SPV, which shall be determined as a function of sales; 
 Construction Company means the company engaged by the SPV for the purpose of construction of the Project ; 
 Construction Management Fee means the service fee equal to a percentage of actual construction costs of the Project to be paid for management of construction through the Construction Company ; 
 Cost of Land means the monetary consideration to be paid by the Joint Venture to the Landowner , which shall be Rs. [●] (R upees [●] ) ; 
 Down Payment means 3 0 % of the Cost of Land i.e. Rs. [●] (Rupees [●] ), to be paid by the Joint Venture as one upfront payment to the Landowner ; 
 Initial Cost means costs to be incurred by the SPV prior to Project launch (as stated in Annexure B) ; 
 Installment means each quarterly installment of the Installment Plan; 
 Installment Plan means the 30 ( thirty ) months’ quarterly payment plan of the Remaining Amount (defined below) ; 
 Joint Venture means the joint venture established between Zameen and Partner for the purposes of undertaking the Project in terms hereof; 
 Landowner means Mr. [●] son of [●] , resident of [●] , holding CNIC No. [●] ; 
 Marketing Company means Zameen Media Private Limited, an entity in dependent of the Parties hereto, whose services shall be employed for exclusive marketing and sales of the Project ; 
 Preliminary Cost means the directly associated cost s that the Partner has hitherto incurred for obtaining approvals , and submissions of the Project from the concerned authorities (as stated in Annexure A ); 
 Project means the prospective high rise commercial real estate project to be devel oped by the SPV on the Property, under the name and style of Zameen Dream Mall (“ Zameen Dream Mall ”, which term shall include infrastructure , construction and development, among other associated acts in the development project ) ; 
 Project Approvals means any and all licenses, permits, consents, planning permits, accreditations, waivers, registrations, authorizations, zoning consents, certificates and approvals, including inter alia approvals related to drawings, planning, building, construction and earthworks, drainage, transmission and distribution of water, sewage, electricity and communications, land division and partitioning, transfer of title, registration of land charges and mortgages, roads and pathways, landscaping, and environmental permits, required from any Government Authority(ies), including but not limited to the Lahore Development Authority (LDA) , with respect to the Project ; 
 Project Approval s Cost means the cost for Project Approvals incurred by the Landowner. 
 Project Expenses mean the general expenses of the joint venture, including inter alia selling, marketing, development, management and operational costs of the SPV; 
 Project Management Committee means the committee formed by the Parties for the overall management of the Project ; 
 Property means the property located at [●] ; 
 Remaining Amount means remaining [●] % of the Land Value and [●] % of the Preliminary Cost to be paid by Zameen to the Partner for purchasing the Property; 
 SPV means an AOP serving as the special purpose vehicle to manage the joint venture between the Parties with respect to infrastructure, construction, development, marketing, and selling of real estate units in the Project . 
 
 This MOU is intended to provide a general framework for further negotiations between the Parties. 
 
 The Parties acknowledge that a business transaction of this nature involves terms and conditions that shall be agreed upon at a subsequent stage and, as such, this MOU shall be non-binding and subject to final definitive agreements that the Parties may execute in the future in accordance with the understanding hereof. 
 
 LAND ACQUISITION 
 
 Partner hereby agrees to sell, and Zameen hereby agrees to purchase, [●] % of the Property for the purpose of entering into a joint venture with respect to the Project. Zameen shall pay Cost of Land to the Partner in accordance with the terms of this MOU. 
 
 Zameen shall pay Down Payment to the Partner as initial consideration for transfer of [●] % ownership of the Property to Zameen. 
 
 Remaining Amount shall be paid by Zameen in accordance with the Installment Plan , which shall commence [●] ( [●] ) months after launch of Project sales. E ach Installment shall be calculated as a pe rcentage of Project sales . For the avoidance of doubt, Zameen shall pay the Remaining Amount within a maximum period of 30 (thirty) months from the commencement of the Installment Plan, notwithstanding any fluctuation in the volume of Project sales. 
 
 Zameen shall pay each Installment to the Partner through Zameen’s drawings from the SPV account until such time as the Remaining Amount has been paid fully to the Partner. Zameen’s drawings for Installment shall be adjusted upon Project completion, so that Zameen’s total drawings from the SPV are equal to the Partner’s drawings from the SPV in accordance with the agreed profit and loss sharing ratio. 
 
 FORMATION OF SPV 
 
 Upon receipt of Down Payment from Zameen , the Partner shall transfer [ ● ] % ownership of the Property to Zameen , and do and cause to be done all such acts necessary and ancillary thereto . 
 
 Upon transfer of Property, as co-owners the Parties shall enter into a joint venture agreement to establish the SPV to undertake the Project on the Property . The P arties shall hold equal ownership in the SPV on a 50/50 profit and loss sharing basis . Further, each Party shall contribute equally to wards any initial capital requirements of the SPV . 
 
 PROJECT STRUCTURE AND MANAGEMENT 
 
 The Parties shall set up a Project Management Committee, with mutual consent, to manage various operations of the SPV including inter alia construction and Construction Management Fee , design, and development of the Project , Initial Costs, facility management of Project after completion, as well as Parties’ drawings from the SPV account . 
 
 The Project Management Committee will hire an independent quantity/quality surveyor and financial auditor for an independent review of the Project’s construction and expenses. 
 
 Project shall be structure d to have LG+G+4 floors, with 2 (two) basement floors to be used for car parking , and the maximum permitted height to be [●] ( [●] ) feet, subject to applicable zoning laws, rules , and regulations. Moreover, the Parties shall mutually agree in writing on the design and concept for the Project, and shall agree a timeline within which the same is to be finalized. Final design and concept , which will include a mall and [●] , shall form an integral part of the business arrangement between the Parties. The remaining civil, structural and architectural development for the Project shall be outsourced to an architectural firm mutually agreed between the Parties. 
 
 Partner represents having submitted construction blueprints, architectural plans , drawings and structural designs for approval of the Project, and having obtained town planning approvals and all other approval(s) necessary for Project’s construction and development from relevant development authorities. 
 
 Construction of the Project shall be undertaken through the Co nstruction C ompany . The Construction Company shall be engaged through an independent service agreement , in accordance with the following terms: 
 
 R ate of construction , estimated at Rs. [●] per sq.ft. , shall always be determined on the basis of actual costs of construction . Once BOQs are finalized, quotations shall be invited from multiple construction companies, and rate of construction shall be approved by the Project Management Committee , subject to market competitive rates ; 
 
 Both Parties to this MOU shall have complete visibility with respect to the actual costs of construction at all time s , which shall factor in escalation/variance of the market cost of raw materials ; and 
 
 Construction Management Fee shall be [●] % ( [●] ) of the construction cost . 
 
 Project sales and marketing shall be exclusively handled by the Marketing Company for a service or marketing fee of 10% (ten percent). The Marketing Company shall share sales targets and marketing plans for the Project with the Parties , to be duly approved by the Project Management Committee . Furthermore, the Marketing Company shall be responsible for recovery of a maximum of 30% (thirty percent) of the unit price. For the avoidance of doubt, the recovery of remaining 70% (seventy percent) of the unit price shall be the responsibility of the SP V . 
 
 Marketing Company shall formally launch the Project once all necessary approvals, clearances, and NOCs from concerned authorities have been provided by the Partner . 
 
 Upon completion of the Project, the Project shall be managed through a mutually agreed facilities management plan . 
 
 OPERATIONS AND FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT 
 
 Each Party shall have complete visibility of the finance and management of the SPV and Project. 
 
 The SPV shall establish a primary joint bank account at such banking facility as mutually agreed between the Parties for management of all costs, revenues and sales of the Project. 
 
 Cash Disbursal Model and payment of Project Expenses shall be a function of cash flows generated from Project sales. Cashflows shall be utilized first towards construction and marketing expenses, followed by payment of Installment as per Clause 6 above. Any amount remaining in the Project account shall be utilized towards Project and construction expenses. 
 
 Zameen shall share with Partner, prior to entering into any formal definitive agreements envisaged in this MOU, projected cashflows expected to be generated through Project sales , along with the percentage to be deducted for the payment of Instalments under the Instalment Plan. 
 
 Dividends shall not be drawn from the SPV or Project account until Project completion , and until the Remaining Amount has b een fully paid by Zameen to Partner , subject to Clause 6 and Clause 23 of this MOU. 
 
 Prior to Project completion, the Parties may, subject to written approval of the Project Management Committee, make drawings from the SPV account of such amount(s), at such time(s), and in such manner as determined by the Project Management Committee, subject to the availability of adequate cash flows and in accordance with the Cash Disbursal Model mutually agreed between the Parties. Any such drawings shall be adjusted upon Project co mpletion, such that each Party’s total drawings from the SPV shall always be in accordance with the agreed profit and loss sharing ratio. 
 
 GENERAL 
 
 Partner warrants that the Partner is the sole, lawful, exclusive, and beneficial owner of the Property and the Property is free from any disputes, claims, liens, mortgages, charges, burdens and encumbrances of any kind whatsoever. In case of any such warranty being untrue, Partner shall indemnify and hold harmless Zameen against all such claims, damages, losses, costs, expenses, encumbrances, charges etc. and Partner shall be exclusively liable to litigate and resolve any such dispute or remove any such encumbrance. 
 
 The Parties agree that the anticipated Project must be financially beneficial to both Parties, and, as such, agree to enter into good faith negotiations to transcribe the terms for formation of SPV. 
 
 The Parties agree to provide customary warranties vis-à-vis their roles and responsibilities in the SPV so formed . Further, Partner shall provide customary warranties, and shall indemnify and hold harmless Zameen with respect to any defect in title or possession of the Property, or third party claims in relation thereto. 
 
 Either Party shall have the right to terminate th eir participation in this MOU unilaterally without cause or notice . Without prejudice to the foregoing, steps shall be taken to ensure that termination of participation in this MOU shall not be prejudicial to any agreed activities or joint projects undertaken within the framework of the MOU or to the completion of tasks for which obligations may exist. 
 
 The Parties agree and understand that this MOU is non-binding and shall be subject to formal definitive agreements that the Parties may execute within a reasonable period of time from the date hereof . Accordingly , the Parties together may undertake detailed negotiations on financial , technical, and legal terms and conditions with a view to enter into formal agreement(s). It is further acknowledged that it is not practically possible to incorporate each and every eventuality in this MOU. Thus, it is understood and declared that any such eventuality that might be unforeseen in this MOU shall be provided for in the agreement(s) with the mutual consent of the P arties thereto. 
 
 This MOU may be amended upon written mutual consent of all Parties hereto, and any such amendment shall be an integral part of this MOU. 
 
 The Parties agree to resolve any dispute between the Parties through direct negotiations in good faith. However, if not resolved within 15 (fifteen ) days of the dispute so arising, it shall be referred for arbitration to be conducted under the Arbitration Act (X of 1940). Arbitration shall be conducted by 3 (three) arbitrators: one to be appointed by each Party, and a third to be appointed mutually by the first two arbitrators. The venue of arbitration shall be Lahore or Islamabad and the language used shall be English. The Decision and award of the arbitrators shall be final, non-appealable and binding on both Parties, including decision as to costs. 
 The Parties acknowledge that this MOU shall be treated as a highly confidential document and its content shall not be disclosed, copied, shared, publicized or circulated in any manner whatsoever, except by mutual written consent of the Parties hereto . 
 
 This joint venture is being formed exclusively and for the limited purposes of the P roject defined herein. The parties stand indemnified completely by each other aga inst any liability except this P roject . 
 
 Neither party will assign or transfer any rights or obligations under this MOU without the prior written consent of the other party.  Any such assignment without prior consent shall be null and void.   
 
 This Agreement MOU may be executed in one or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which together shall constitute one instrument. 
 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this MOU as of the date first written above :
